description: Insufficient-data and invalid-parameter failure scenarios for CalculateMACD. Three sub-cases: (1) empty input, (2) 34 prices with 12/26/9 (need 35 = slow+signalPeriod), (3) fast >= slow (invalid periods). All must return a non-nil error and zero-length output arrays.

expectedOutput.note: All three cases MUST return a non-nil error. Output arrays MUST be nil/empty. No partial results are acceptable.
